findings.title: Define the manifest loader used by runtime verification
findings.body: `runtime_verify()` calls `load_spec`, but that name is neither defined nor imported in `controls.py`. Every real replay reaches this call through `before_import()` and raises `NameError`, preventing runtime verification, all checkpoint forwards, and the independent audit even with a valid authenticated gate. Use the existing pinned file reader or define the missing loader. The invented tests mock `runtime_verify()`, so they do not expose this failure.

overall_explanation: The production replay path unconditionally fails at runtime manifest loading because its loader is undefined. Review was limited to the supplied public packet; no tests or external artifacts were accessed.
